title: Strong S&P 500 Earnings Provide Support as AI Stocks Remain Volatile
excerpt: Strong second-quarter corporate earnings are helping support U. S.
content_html:
Fiona Craig

Sun, August 9, 2026 at 7:40 AM MST 3 min read

Strong second-quarter corporate earnings are helping support U.S. equities despite continued turbulence among artificial intelligence-related stocks, according to Goldman Sachs. The bank believes recent weakness in momentum-driven AI names resembles previous periods of consolidation rather than necessarily signalling the end of the investment theme.

AI Stocks Enter Consolidation After Powerful Rally

Goldman strategists led by Ben Snider said recent volatility has followed a familiar historical pattern after periods of exceptionally strong momentum.

"AI stock volatility during the past week has continued to follow the typical historical pattern following sharp Momentum rallies," the strategists said.

Previous extreme momentum rallies have frequently been followed by corrections or periods of consolidation, resembling the recent pullback in AI-related shares.

While corporate earnings will ultimately determine whether the trade regains momentum, Goldman said historical evidence combined with recent reductions in investor leverage "suggest an improved outlook going forward."

Earnings Beats Reach Historically Strong Levels

By July 31, around 61% of S&P 500 companies had released their quarterly results, with 64% beating consensus earnings-per-share expectations by at least one standard deviation, representing one of the strongest performances on record.

Excluding "other income" generated by gains on equity investments held by mega-cap technology companies, S&P 500 earnings are tracking approximately 26% higher year-over-year. Including those investment gains pushes headline EPS growth to 45%.

The median company in the index is meanwhile on course to deliver EPS growth of around 12%, comfortably exceeding the 9% consensus forecast heading into earnings season.

AI infrastructure companies account for approximately one-third of the overall earnings expansion.

Technology Stocks Receive Muted Response to Earnings Beats

Despite impressive corporate results, investors have not rewarded every earnings beat equally.

Goldman noted that "the reaction to earnings beats has been lackluster for Technology, Media, and Telecommunications (TMT) stocks," while "the equal-weight S&P 500 has continued to climb alongside steady EPS growth."

Within TMT, the median company beating earnings expectations underperformed the S&P 500 by 192 basis points during the session following its results. In comparison, companies outside the sector that exceeded expectations generated median outperformance of 75 basis points.

content_html_zh:
菲奥娜·克雷格

2026 年 8 月 9 日星期日上午 7:40（MST） 阅读 3 分钟

高盛表示，尽管人工智能相关股票持续动荡，但强劲的第二季度企业盈利正在帮助支撑美国股市。 该银行认为，近期动量驱动的人工智能名称的疲软类似于之前的整合时期，而不一定预示着投资主题的结束。

人工智能股在强劲反弹后进入盘整

以本·斯奈德为首的高盛策略师表示，在经历了异常强劲的势头之后，近期的波动遵循了熟悉的历史模式。

策略师表示：“过去一周人工智能股票的波动继续遵循动力强劲反弹后的典型历史模式。”

之前的极端势头反弹之后经常会出现修正或盘整期，类似于最近人工智能相关股票的回调。

高盛表示，虽然企业盈利最终将决定交易是否重获动力，但历史证据加上近期投资者杠杆的降低“表明未来前景有所改善”。

盈利达到历史最高水平

截至 7 月 31 日，约 61% 的标准普尔 500 指数公司公布了季度业绩，其中 64% 的每股收益超出市场普遍预期至少一个标准差，这是有记录以来最强劲的表现之一。

不包括大型科技公司持有的股权投资收益产生的“其他收入”，标准普尔 500 指数的盈利同比增长约 26%。 计入这些投资收益后，整体每股收益增长率将达到 45%。

与此同时，该指数中的中位公司每股收益预计将增长 12% 左右，轻松超过盈利季节前 9% 的普遍预测。

人工智能基础设施公司约占整体盈利扩张的三分之一。

科技股对盈利预期反应平淡

尽管企业业绩令人印象深刻，但投资者并没有对每一项超出预期的盈利给予同等的回报。

高盛指出，“科技、媒体和电信 (TMT) 股票对盈利好转的反应一直乏善可陈”，而“等权重标准普尔 500 指数随着每股收益的稳定增长而继续攀升”。

在 TMT 领域，盈利预期中值的公司在公布业绩后的盘中表现比标准普尔 500 指数低 192 个基点。 相比之下，超出预期的行业外公司的表现中位数超出预期 75 个基点。
